verdict.rationale: Texas Workforce Commission is a state government agency that runs public online services such as UTR and UTS tax registration and filing. Self-hosting the agency's core system is a category error for this kind of product. The installable QuickFile tool is a local file-reporting client that submits to TWC, not a self-hosted deployment of the core product, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
